display.fontFamily: IBM Plex Sans, IBM Plex Sans Thai, system-ui, sans-serif
display.purpose: Page titles and high-level report titles only.

body.fontFamily: IBM Plex Sans, IBM Plex Sans Thai, system-ui, sans-serif
body.purpose: Dense Thai and English UI text, table cells, and workflow copy.

label.fontFamily: IBM Plex Sans, IBM Plex Sans Thai, system-ui, sans-serif
label.purpose: Controls, navigation, field labels, and filter labels.

meta.fontFamily: IBM Plex Sans, IBM Plex Sans Thai, system-ui, sans-serif
meta.purpose: text-meta 13/20: breadcrumbs, meta lines, table headers, hints and errors, status badge text, sm buttons, chips and menu trails.

metric.fontFamily: IBM Plex Sans, IBM Plex Sans Thai, system-ui, sans-serif
metric.purpose: text-metric 28/32, weight 500, -0.02em: stat values. Numbers only, always with num.

count.fontFamily: IBM Plex Sans, IBM Plex Sans Thai, system-ui, sans-serif
count.purpose: text-count 20/24, weight 600, -0.01em: counts in rows and compact stats. Numbers only, always with num.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: shadow-overlay: dialogs, sheets, popovers, dropdown menus and toasts only. Panels, cards, and the topbar are flat.

shadows.name: field-focus
shadows.purpose: shadow-field-focus: the halo around a focused field (with a 1px ring) and an open SearchableSelect. Not elevation.

shadows.name: field-error
shadows.purpose: shadow-field-error: the halo around an unfocused field with aria-invalid. Not elevation.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Hover, focus, selection, and state feedback only.

motion.name: menu-open
motion.value: 160ms ease-out fade + 4px slide in; 100ms fade out; no zoom
motion.purpose: Dropdown menus, submenus and popovers. motion-reduce:animate-none! turns it off.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Disable nonessential transitions for users who request reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action button (Button variant default) for save, create, submit, approve, or workflow-forward actions. Disabled and busy buttons turn grey with faint text instead of fading.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; border: 1px solid #1E4F94; background: #1E4F94; color: #FFFFFF; border-radius: 8px; font: 500 14px/1.5714 "IBM Plex Sans", "IBM Plex Sans Thai", system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out, border-color 150ms ease-out, color 150ms ease-out; } @media (min-width: 768px) { .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 0; height: 40px; } } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #173E76; border-color: #173E76; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #083161; border-color: #083161; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #10858D; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled, .ds-btn-primary[aria-disabled="true"] { background: #F6F8FB; border-color: #D7DEE8; color: #56677F; cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-btn-primary[aria-disabled="true"] { pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Secondary action (Button variant outline) for filters, navigation-adjacent actions, and lower-priority commands. Its #C3CDDA border is decorative; the label says it is a button.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; border: 1px solid #C3CDDA; background: #FFFFFF; color: #0B1D35; border-radius: 8px; font: 500 14px/1.5714 "IBM Plex Sans", "IBM Plex Sans Thai", system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out, border-color 150ms ease-out, color 150ms ease-out; } @media (min-width: 768px) { .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 0; height: 40px; } } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #F6F8FB; border-color: #7C8BA0; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background: #E9EEF5; border-color: #7C8BA0; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #10858D; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled, .ds-btn-secondary[aria-disabled="true"] { background: #F6F8FB; border-color: #D7DEE8; color: #56677F; cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-btn-secondary[aria-disabled="true"] { pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Standard form field (Input, NativeSelect or Textarea inside Field) for asset, employee, location, search, and settings fields. White fill, 3:1 border, focus halo, error through aria-invalid.
components.html: Letters, digits and dashes
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; font-family: "IBM Plex Sans", "IBM Plex Sans Thai", system-ui, sans-serif; color: #0B1D35; } .ds-field-label { font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.5385; font-weight: 500; } .ds-field-hint { margin: 0; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.5385; color: #56677F; } .ds-input { box-sizing: border-box; height: 44px; width: 100%; border: 1px solid #7C8BA0; border-radius: 8px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #0B1D35; padding: 0 12px; font: 400 16px/1.5 "IBM Plex Sans", "IBM Plex Sans Thai", system-ui, sans-serif; outline: none; transition: border-color 150ms ease-out, box-shadow 150ms ease-out; } @media (min-width: 768px) { .ds-input { height: 40px; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5714; } } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #56677F; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #10858D; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #10858D, 0 0 0 4px rgb(16 133 141 / 0.16); } .ds-input[aria-invalid="true"] { border-color: #B3261E; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #B3261E, 0 0 0 4px rgb(179 38 30 / 0.14); } .ds-input[aria-invalid="true"]:focus { border-color: #10858D; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #10858D, 0 0 0 4px rgb(16 133 141 / 0.16); } .ds-input:disabled { background: #F6F8FB; border-color: #D7DEE8; color: #56677F; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Choice Card
components.description: ChoiceCard: a full-width radio or checkbox option on the browser's own input, which stays visible, with an optional description. 8px corners, control-border line; the chosen card has a primary border and the primary-soft fill. Enter never submits the form; Space picks.
components.html: Handover mode
components.css: .ds-choice-group { min-width: 0; margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 0; display: grid; gap: 8px; font-family: "IBM Plex Sans", "IBM Plex Sans Thai", system-ui, sans-serif; color: #0B1D35; } .ds-choice-legend { margin-bottom: 6px; padding: 0; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.5385; font-weight: 500; } .ds-choice-card { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 12px; min-height: 44px; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid #C3CDDA; border-radius: 8px; background: #FFFFFF; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5714; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 150ms ease-out, background-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-choice-card:hover { border-color: #7C8BA0; } .ds-choice-card:has(input:checked) { border-color: #1E4F94; background: #E9EFF8; } .ds-choice-card input { flex: 0 0 auto; width: 16px; height: 16px; margin: 2px 0 0; accent-color: #1E4F94; cursor: pointer; } .ds-choice-card input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #10858D; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-choice-title { display: block; font-weight: 500; } .ds-choice-detail { display: block; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.5385; color: #3C4F6B; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-choice-card { transition: none; } }

components.name: Choice Chip
components.description: ChoiceChip: a small inline radio or checkbox option on the browser's own input, with an optional faint detail such as a count. 6px corners, 32px from 768px and 44px below; the chosen chip has a primary-border line, the primary-soft fill and primary-hover text.
components.css: .ds-chip-row { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; font-family: "IBM Plex Sans", "IBM Plex Sans Thai", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-choice-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 4px 12px; border: 1px solid #C3CDDA; border-radius: 6px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #0B1D35; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5714; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 150ms ease-out, background-color 150ms ease-out, color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-choice-chip:hover { border-color: #7C8BA0; } .ds-choice-chip:has(input:checked) { border-color: #BACBE4; background: #E9EFF8; color: #173E76; } .ds-choice-chip input { flex: 0 0 auto; width: 16px; height: 16px; margin: 0; accent-color: #1E4F94; cursor: pointer; } .ds-choice-chip input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #10858D; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-chip-detail { font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.5385; color: #56677F; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } @media (min-width: 768px) { .ds-choice-chip { min-height: 32px; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-choice-chip { transition: none; } }

Secondary first, primary last: phones stack the buttons full width with Cancel on top, and from 640px they form a right-aligned row. On phones the box sits above the iPhone home bar.
components.html:
Record repair result

The body scrolls on its own; the footer stays in view.

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: One StatusBadge in one size (22px, 13/20 text, 6px corners) and two tiers with shape-coded markers. Calm tier (info ring, success/primary dot, neutral-ink bar): no fill or side padding, muted-foreground text. Attention tier (warning triangle, danger diamond): soft fill, border, 8px side padding and tone ink. Every badge carries a text label; database status colors are not shown. In high-contrast mode markers use the system text color.
components.html: เปิด รอตรวจสอบ
components.css: .ds-status-badge { box-sizing: border-box; display: inline-flex; height: 22px; width: fit-content; max-width: 100%; align-items: center; gap: 6px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; padding: 0; background: transparent; color: #3C4F6B; font: 500 13px/1.5385 "IBM Plex Sans", "IBM Plex Sans Thai", system-ui, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-status-marker { flex: 0 0 auto; forced-color-adjust: none; } .ds-status-info .ds-status-marker { width: 7px; height: 7px; border: 1.5px solid #0A6E75; border-radius: 9999px; } .ds-status-success .ds-status-marker { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #1D7A35; } .ds-status-primary .ds-status-marker { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #1E4F94; } .ds-status-neutral .ds-status-marker { width: 7px; height: 2px; border-radius: 1px; background: #2A4468; } .ds-status-warning { padding: 0 8px; background: #FDF4E4; border-color: #EDCB93; color: #A14A05; } .ds-status-warning .ds-status-marker { width: 8px; height: 7px; background: #A14A05; clip-path: polygon(50% 0, 100% 100%, 0 100%); } .ds-status-danger { padding: 0 8px; background: #FCEFEE; border-color: #F1BEB9; color: #B3261E; } .ds-status-danger .ds-status-marker { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 1px; background: #B3261E; transform: rotate(45deg); } @media (forced-colors: active) { .ds-status-marker { background: CanvasText; } .ds-status-info .ds-status-marker { background: transparent; border-color: CanvasText; } }

components.name: Sidebar Navigation Item
components.description: RBAC-filtered row in the white sidebar (three sections with headings). Full-width rounded row inside the nav's 8px (px-2) gutter (the margin below stands in for that gutter), sidebar-muted icon, Sidebar Hover; each section is role=group labelled by its heading. The active row is solid navy with white text and a teal icon, with an outline in Windows high-contrast mode; aria-current=page only on the exact page, aria-current=true on the entry above a detail page. Its focus ring sits outside the row on white.
components.html: Dashboard
components.css: .ds-nav-item { min-height: 36px; margin: 0 8px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 8px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #1F3657; text-decoration: none; font: 500 14px/1.5714 "IBM Plex Sans", "IBM Plex Sans Thai", system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out, color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-nav-item svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; flex: 0 0 auto; color: #586A84; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: #EBF0F7; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #10858D; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-nav-item-active, .ds-nav-item-active:hover { background: #083161; color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-nav-item-active svg { color: #18A0A8; } @media (forced-colors: active) { .ds-nav-item-active { outline: 2px solid CanvasText; outline-offset: -2px; } }

narrative.overview: This visual system should feel like a trusted enterprise record system for asset ownership, custody, audit, maintenance, disposal, reporting, and administration. It is structured, accountable, and operationally reliable. The interface serves real Thai corporate operations, so the design language is calm, corporate, data-driven, and practical.
keyCharacteristics: Dense enough for enterprise scanning, never cramped.
Bordered and tonal by default; only floating layers are lifted.
Status-rich, permission-aware, and readable in Thai and English.
Built for desktop administration and mobile field audit work.

rules.name: The Where Color Lives Rule
rules.body: Navy #083161 lives only in the logo and the selected menu row. Actions and links use Primary #1E4F94. Teal is for info status, the focus ring (#10858D) and the selected menu icon. Green, orange and red appear only inside status badges, as the icon of a toast, a Notice or an ActionEmptyState, and on destructive buttons and menu items; only warning and danger toasts and Notice boxes get a soft fill. Until phase 2D, info notices, role chips and a few info icons also use the info tokens and so appear teal (phase 2A changed only their borders).

rules.name: The Status With Evidence Rule
rules.body: Status cues must never rely on color alone. Pair semantic color with readable labels, marker shapes, consistent tone mapping, and visible workflow context.

rules.name: The No Decorative Gradient Rule
rules.body: Decorative gradients are prohibited. The product should feel like an enterprise operations system, not a landing page.

rules.name: The Token Contrast Rule
rules.body: Status text uses the status ink (text-success, text-warning, text-danger, text-info) on white, the page background, canvas, muted, accent, row-hover, or its own soft surface (bg-{tone}-soft). Never tint with opacity (bg-warning/10, bg-primary/10, border-warning/30, bg-muted/40) and never lighten solid fills on hover (/90): use the -soft, -border and -hover tokens and the solid neutrals (bg-background, bg-row-hover, border-border-soft). Faint text (#56677F) is AA on every neutral surface and on primary-soft, never on a status soft fill. tests/design-tokens-contrast.test.ts enforces every text pair at 4.5:1 and rings, field borders and meaningful icons at 3:1; button outlines are decorative.

rules.name: The No Display Labels Rule
rules.body: Never use display fonts, fluid hero type, or oversized marketing typography for labels, buttons, data, navigation, or form controls.

rules.name: The Thai Line-Height Rule
rules.body: text-sm is 22/14 in every language; Thai pages raise text-xs, text-xl, text-2xl and text-3xl to 18/12, 30/20, 36/24 and 44/30. text-meta (20/13) needs no Thai override; text-metric and text-count hold numbers only. A4 operation documents keep text-sm at 20/14 so the signature row stays on page 1.

rules.name: The Thai Readability Rule
rules.body: Thai and English labels must remain readable at operational density. Do not shrink helper text or placeholders below accessible contrast or touch usability.

rules.name: The Border First Rule
rules.body: Use a border and tonal surface for grouping. Panels, cards, sections, and the topbar are flat; only dialogs, sheets, popovers, menus, and toasts use shadow-overlay (dialogs and sheets over a bg-scrim backdrop). Six shadow-sm stay on controls over a camera image or photo and on paper previews; a per-file budget guard keeps the rest from coming back.

rules.name: The No Floating Marketing Cards Rule
rules.body: Panels must not become decorative cards arranged for landing-page drama.

dos: Do preserve existing tokens and shared primitives such as Button, Segmented, the field primitives (Input, NativeSelect, Textarea, Field, SearchField), the dialog parts (AccessibleDialogBody, AccessibleDialogFooter, AccessibleDialogCancel), StickyFormFooter, ChoiceCard and ChoiceChip, Steps, FormSection, FileQueueList, Notice, EmptyNote, ActionEmptyState, and the panel, table shell and mobile card list helpers.
Do keep navy #083161 for the logo and the selected menu row, Primary #1E4F94 for actions and links, and teal for info status, focus and the selected menu icon.
Do use borders and tonal layers as the grouping mechanism; use shadow-overlay only for dialogs, sheets, popovers and menus, and bg-scrim behind them.
Do keep tables and forms dense enough for enterprise scanning, but not cramped.
Do pair status colors with readable labels, marker shapes, icons, or explicit workflow context so status does not rely on color alone.

Do support Thai and English text, keyboard navigation, visible focus states, reduced motion, touch-safe mobile/tablet controls, and clear empty, loading, error, permission-denied, and validation states.
Do preserve business workflows, RBAC, locale routing, audit trail expectations, Prisma/SQL Server behavior, and production readiness assumptions.
donts: Don't use consumer-app styling, bright playful colors, heavy animation, marketing-style hero layouts, gamified UI, casual startup dashboards, decorative gradients, or anything that makes the system feel like a landing page instead of an enterprise operations tool.
Don't use glassmorphism, heavy shadows, decorative gradients, floating marketing cards, or playful surfaces.
Don't bring back a dark navy sidebar, a second focus color, or green, orange and red outside status badges.
Don't show database status colors on badges, or use teal brand-accent as text.
Don't redesign business workflows for visual effect.
Don't invent inconsistent button, input, modal, badge, or navigation vocabularies across screens.
Don't rely on color alone for status, permission, validation, audit, or lifecycle state.
Don't use display fonts, fluid hero typography, gradient text, oversized cards, or landing-page composition inside product workflows.
Don't use colored side-stripe borders as a decorative accent. Use full borders, status badges, text labels, and icons instead.

Don't change a button's label while it is busy, put the primary action first in the DOM (flex-col-reverse), drop required or maxLength from a control when it moves into Field, or give a dialog its own form when it renders inside another form.
